guidance.claim: We remain on track to reach $2 billion by March 2027.
guidance.quote: I am also happy to share that we remain firmly on track, advancing confidently towards our aspiration of $2 billion by March 2027 and laying the foundation of $5 billion by March 2031.
guidance.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

guidance.claim: We are laying the foundation to reach $5 billion by March 2031.
guidance.quote: Over the course of this intensive offsite, we not only charted our priorities and focus areas for FY27 but also assessed our progress towards our long-term aspiration of reaching $5 billion in annual revenue by FY31 and did intensive trainings on the AI side for our entire leadership.
guidance.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

guidance.claim: ETR for FY26 will be in the range of 20% to 24%.
guidance.quote: ETR for FY26 will be in the range of 20%-24%.
guidance.speaker: Vinit Teredesai

reported.claim: Q3 FY26 revenue reached $422.5 million, up 17.3% year-on-year.
reported.quote: We achieved a healthy revenue growth of 4.0% quarter-on-quarter and 17.3% year-on-year, delivering $422.5 million in Q3 of fiscal 2026.
reported.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

reported.claim: Q3 FY26 EBIT margin came in at 14.4%.
reported.quote: After accounting for this impact, the EBIT for the quarter came in at 14.4%, which translates into a decline of 7.0% quarter-on-quarter and an increase of 19.1% year-on-year in absolute terms.
reported.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

reported.claim: Q3 FY26 Profit After Tax margin came in at 11.6%.
reported.quote: Profit After Tax for the quarter came in at 11.6%, a decline of 6.8% quarter-on-quarter and an increase of 17.8% year-on-year in absolute terms.
reported.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

reported.claim: Total Contract Value for the quarter stood at USD 674.5 million.
reported.quote: The Total Contract Value for the quarter stood at USD 674.5 million with the Total Contract Value of new bookings coming in at USD 369.1 million.
reported.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

reported.claim: Annual Contract Value of bookings for the quarter was USD 501.9 million.
reported.quote: The Annual Contract Value of bookings for the quarter is USD 501.9 million out of which the ACV from new bookings contributed USD 255.8 million.
reported.speaker: Sandeep Kalra

reported.claim: Total headcount stood at 26,711 at the end of Q3 FY26.
reported.quote: At the end of Q3 FY26, our total headcount stood at 26,711, an increase of 487 from the previous quarter.
reported.speaker: Vinit Teredesai
